description: Position a single cell in grid mode. x/y/w are integers in the react-grid-layout grid; width is limited to 12 columns. Cell height is derived from its semantic pane dimensions. The response includes the applied grid position plus the cell's presented `view` and `mode`; editor-only and markdown cells report mode null, and markdown also reports view null. Use set_cell_dimensions to resize a cell or change its `view`.
name: set_cell_layout
